A [[Gender|male]]<ref name="SC 106 ST" /> '''pirate''' was active during the [[New Republic Era]], belonging to [[Captain]] [[Brutus]]' [[Silvo's pirates|pirate crew]].<ref name="SC 106" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref>{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> they were present at former [[Captain]] [[Jod Na Nawood|Silvo]]'s trial. Originally receiving a [[Death penalty|death sentence]], Silvo was allotted a few [[Time|moments]] for his [[Right of Last Appeal|last appeal]] after [[pirate]] [[Chaelt]] interceded for him, invoking the [[Pirate's Code]]. The former captain began his speech by outlining the situation of the crew, at which point the male pirate asked their fellow crew members what the defendant was on about. When Silvo noticed that all of them were hungry for [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]], which were never enough, the male individual concurred, saying out loud that Silvo was right. Ultimately, the defendant had his life spared for the time being, with the reservation that he would be [[Death|killed]] in the event that the [[planet]] [[At Attin]]—where he promised to lead the crew—yielded no treasure.<ref name="SC 106" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Gender|male]] [[pirate]]'s voice was first heard in "[[Zero Friends Again]]," the sixth episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'',<ref name="SC 106" /> which premiered on [[December 31]], [[2024]], streaming on [[Disney+]],<ref name="Premiere">{{Twitter|StarWars|status/1861409832349172011|[[Star Wars]]|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/QwMYe}}</ref> with the character's gender provided in the subtitles.<ref name="SC 106 ST" />
